_comment: Fidelity config for SGB→SPX 划转 screen (917:7331). Tolerances + font aliases mirror the SGB-account config. RN-web ships SpxBrand-* PostScript names for fontFamilyForWeight() — alias them to HarmonyOS Sans TC so the diff treats brand-face glyphs as canonical CJK weights, not novel families.

deviations.reason: Figma seeds the 实收金额 hero value at fontWeight 900 (HarmonyOS Sans TC Black). The app ships only Plus Jakarta Sans Bold (700) bundled as the brand face — RN-Web clamps Black to 700. Visual difference imperceptible at 16px. Same waiver pattern as docs/figma-sgb-account/fidelity for 美元账户/港币账户 weights. Approved 2026-05-28.
